question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.

-- Let me verify the tie case for match 392207
SELECT match_id,
       CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1 > p2) THEN p1 ELSE p2 END as player_1_id,
       CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1 > p2) THEN p2 ELSE p1 END as player_2_id,
       CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1 > p2) THEN score1 ELSE score2 END as player_1_score,
       CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1 > p2) THEN score2 ELSE score1 END as player_2_score,
       partnership_runs
FROM (
    WITH individual_runs AS (
        SELECT b.match_id, b.striker as player_id, SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as runs
        FROM ball_by_ball b
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
          ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
    ),
    partnerships AS (
        SELECT b.match_id,
               CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END as p1,
               CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END as p2,
               SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as partnership_runs
        FROM ball_by_ball b
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
          ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        GROUP BY b.match_id, 
                 CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END,
                 CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    ),
    max_partnerships AS (
        SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
        FROM partnerships
        GROUP BY match_id
    ),
    top_partnerships AS (
        SELECT p.match_id, p.p1, p.p2, p.partnership_runs,
               COALESCE(ir1.runs, 0) as score1, COALESCE(ir2.runs, 0) as score2
        FROM partnerships p
        JOIN max_partnerships mp ON p.match_id = mp.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
        LEFT JOIN individual_runs ir1 ON p.match_id = ir1.match_id AND p.p1 = ir1.player_id
        LEFT JOIN individual_runs ir2 ON p.match_id = ir2.match_id AND p.p2 = ir2.player_id
    )
    SELECT * FROM top_partnerships WHERE match_id = 392207
)

    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker as player_id, SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
partnerships AS (
    SELECT b.match_id,
           CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END as p1,
           CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END as p2,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, 
             CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END,
             CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT p.match_id, p.p1, p.p2, p.partnership_runs,
           COALESCE(ir1.runs, 0) as score1, COALESCE(ir2.runs, 0) as score2
    FROM partnerships p
    JOIN max_partnerships mp ON p.match_id = mp.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
    LEFT JOIN individual_runs ir1 ON p.match_id = ir1.match_id AND p.p1 = ir1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN individual_runs ir2 ON p.match_id = ir2.match_id AND p.p2 = ir2.player_id
)
SELECT match_id,
       CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1 > p2) THEN p1 ELSE p2 END as player_1_id,
       CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1 > p2) THEN p2 ELSE p1 END as player_2_id,
       CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1 > p2) THEN score1 ELSE score2 END as player_1_score,
       CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1 > p2) THEN score2 ELSE score1 END as player_2_score,
       partnership_runs
FROM top_partnerships
ORDER BY match_id, player_1_id, player_2_id
